Indian Commodity Markets Show Mixed Trends in Mandi Prices

Commodity markets across India experienced varied price movements on a given day. In Kota, mustard and coriander prices declined, while gram prices saw an increase. Sugar prices also registered a fall in the Kota mandi. Meanwhile, reports from Kanpur indicated prices for wheat, pulses, rice, gold, and silver.
